description: Ristorante Voga — authentic Italian restaurant & wine bar in Saint-Jérôme. Elegant, warm, French-first bilingual marketing site with a swappable reservation widget.

promptHistory.prompt: Design a modern, elegant website for Ristorante Voga, an authentic Italian restaurant and wine bar at 330 Rue Saint-Georges in Saint-Jérôme. Warm, upscale, distinctly Italian. Burgundy, charcoal, warm ivory, olive and subtle gold; elegant serif headings, clean body text. Sections: story, signature dishes, menu, wine, seven-course tasting, current promotion, gallery, reviews, hours, location, contact. French default + full English. Réservez is the main CTA, wired to a swappable third-party reservation widget (no custom booking DB). Separate contact form that cannot be used for reservations. Mobile-friendly, fast, accessible, SEO-friendly, backend-editable.
